title: Disk layout convention: ESP at /boot/efi, /boot on root fs, ESP automounted
description: FAT is required for the ESP but corrupts on power loss mid-write. Convention for new disko layouts: GRUB, ESP mounted at /boot/efi (noauto + x-systemd.automount, idle timeout), /boot on the journaled root fs; BIOS-only VMs need no ESP. Acceptance: shared disko helper or documented template in docs/, clan-spike reinstalled with it and boots; existing hosts adopt it when reinstalled during migration.
close_reason: Shared disko helper modules/_lib/disko-layout.nix (and flake.lib.diskoLayout) implemented with RFC 145 doc comments; clan-spike disko.nix converted; docs/disk-layout.md written

title: Port router role as den aspect with standby/primary mode
description: Port unified hosts/nixos/router/role.nix (+ modules/nixos/router/{common,snmp}.nix) as den.aspects.router-role on top of the nix-router-optimized flake input (pin the rev in unified's flake.lock). Per-host settings come from inventory: add a typed router submodule to homelab.hosts (mode = standby|primary, devices, LAN/management addresses, wanBandwidth, vrrpPriority) and map unified's elitedesk configuration.nix (ownLanServices=false semantics) to mode=standby. Secrets come from den.aspects.router-secrets vars; set group/mode there for kea and router-dashboard. Fold elitedesk's current networking (modules/hosts/elitedesk.nix) into the role without losing management reachability or loose rpfilter. Leave user passwords as TODO. Add a flake check that fails if any standby host can bring its WAN up or run DHCP on it. Acceptance: elitedesk toplevel builds; a documented sample of options matches unified's elitedesk config; check passes; no deploy.
close_reason: Ported typed den router role, Clan credentials and standby checks. Compared evaluated unified elitedesk options and built and checked locally.

title: Router election design and failover rehearsal runbook

Write docs/router-failover.md: a rehearsal runbook for a standby taking over (preconditions, steps, what to observe: LAN, WAN, IPv6 PD, DHCP leases, DNS, time to fail back), plus a results-log template that records observations only and links commits for configuration (no duplicated config). Note the physical setup: modem -> unmanaged switch -> router WAN and elitedesk WAN. Acceptance: docs reviewed; no code changes.
close_reason: Documented router election design in docs/router-election.md and failover rehearsal runbook with observations results-log template in docs/router-failover.md

title: Replicate the local DNS zone to standby routers
description: router's deepwatercreature.com records live only in its Technitium runtime state (Kea DDNS fills them); a standby (elitedesk) answers none of them, so after failover every local name breaks. Neither unified's nor this repo's config declares the zone. Design: standby Technitium as a secondary for the zone (zone transfer/notify from the primary, or catalog zones), plus how DDNS updates reach whichever router is primary after a takeover. Acceptance: elitedesk answers router/emerald/pve-rog/homeserver the same as router; documented in docs/router-election.md.

title: nix-router-optimized: file-path options instead of age.secrets lookups
description: Several nix-router-optimized modules resolve credentials via config.age.secrets.<name> (agenix only), so nix-clan-homelab declares disabled agenix aliases pointing at clan var paths (modules/aspects/router-secrets.nix). Upstream fix in deepwatrcreatur/nix-router-optimized: add *File path options (keeping *SecretName for compatibility), with eval checks and docs; then bump the input here and drop the aliases and the agenix import. Acceptance: router-role evaluates without inputs.agenix; upstream PR merged.

title: Promote replicated DNS zones on VRRP takeover
description: A standby holds deepwatercreature.com and 10.10.in-addr.arpa as Technitium Secondary zones (nch-sny.28), which are read-only. When VRRP makes it MASTER, Kea DDNS updates fail until the zones are promoted to Primary (zones/convert); on BACKUP they must return to Secondary of the new primary, after which they resync. Acceptance: keepalived notify hooks convert zones both ways; a failover rehearsal shows a DHCP client's name registered on the new MASTER and visible on the peer after fail-back. Blocks enabling router-ha.

title: elitedesk X520 LAN port dropped off PCIe
description: At 2026-11-18 17:13:33 EST, ~2.5 h after boot, the kernel logged 'ixgbe 0000:01:00.1: Adapter removed' and 'firmware error detected FWSM: 0xFFFFFFFF'; enp1s0f1 (LAN, DAC) lost carrier. No AER or thermal messages. Driver rebind and PCI FLR both failed (probe error -5); a warm reboot restored the port at 10 Gb/s. A router whose LAN NIC can vanish is not fit to be primary. Investigate: card temperature and airflow (X520s run hot in small chassis), PCIe ASPM (try pcie_aspm=off), slot seating, firmware; add a Prometheus alert for ixgbe 'Adapter removed' and link loss; watch for recurrence over a multi-day soak. Acceptance: root cause or mitigation applied, plus 7 days without recurrence before elitedesk becomes primary.

title: omasnap fails its checkPhase in the Nix sandbox

Fix the test environment (set XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/HOME, offscreen QPA, stub hyprctl) or disable the failing tests with a WHY; add a build check. Acceptance: nix build of omasnap succeeds and a check builds it.
